recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸液中小淋巴球、帶偏心核與深藍胞質的漿細胞樣淋巴球（plasmacytoid lymphocytes）以及成熟漿細胞混雜成一個連續光譜，其間散在帶顆粒的嗜酸性細胞；小淋巴球到漿細胞的逐步分化，是淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤／Waldenström 巨球蛋白血症的抽吸液表現。
features: Spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and mature plasma cells
Plasmacytoid cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped clock-face chromatin and moderately basophilic cytoplasm, some with perinuclear hof
Small lymphocytes with condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm predominating in clusters
Scattered granulated cells including eosinophils; occasional segmented neutrophils
Mast cells not clearly identified in this field; residual erythroid and myeloid precursors present
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an increase in lymphoid cells forming a continuous spectrum from small lymphocytes with condensed chromatin to plasmacytoid lymphocytes with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm and mature plasma cells with perinuclear hofs. Scattered eosinophils, neutrophils and residual hematopoietic precursors are present. No large transformed cells are evident in this field. In a patient with an IgM paraprotein, the findings are consistent with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma (Waldenström macroglobulinemia), to be supported by flow cytometry showing a clonal B-cell and plasma cell population and MYD88 L265P testing.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Can be morphologically identical, so MYD88 L265P (present in >90% of LPL) and the pattern of involvement help separate them.
Myeloma consists of clonal plasma cells without an accompanying clonal CD19+/CD20+ B-cell component and often shows CCND1 translocation in IgM cases.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia with plasmacytoid features
ddx.vs: CLL has monotonous small lymphocytes with a CD5+/CD23+ phenotype and lacks a prominent plasma cell continuum.
Reactive plasma cells are polytypic with no clonal B-cell population and no monoclonal IgM.
